states.claim: profile is the EXIF StringInfo obtained from the image profile; its datum storage is the byte buffer later traversed as exif.
exif points to the byte storage region of profile and is advanced while scanning for the EXIF header.
directory is initialized as an interior pointer into the exif byte storage region at the first IFD offset.
directory_stack entries store directory pointers, entry indices, and tag offsets for nested IFD traversal.
q is an interior pointer into the exif storage region derived from directory and the current entry index.
p is initialized to point within the directory entry when the value fits in four bytes.
p is initialized as an interior pointer into the exif storage region at dir_offset when the value does not fit in four bytes.
p1 is initialized from p inside the EXIFMultipleValues and EXIFMultipleFractions macros and is advanced by size per component.
value is allocated as a new string buffer for formatted EXIF values and later destroyed.
states.evidence:
L46: value=AcquireString(buffer); \
L72: value=AcquireString(buffer); \
L663: value=(char *) AcquireQuantumMemory((size_t) number_bytes+1UL,
L737: value=(char *) AcquireQuantumMemory((size_t) number_bytes+1UL,
L816: value=DestroyString(value);

states.claim: key is allocated as a new string and later destroyed.
exif_resources is a newly created SplayTree resource used to track visited directory entries and is destroyed before return.
states.evidence:
L576: exif_resources=NewSplayTree((int (*)(const void *,const void *)) NULL,
L869: exif_resources=DestroySplayTree(exif_resources);

states.claim: directory_stack entries are assigned interior pointers into the exif storage region for nested IFD offsets.

values.claim: tag_bytes is a 13-element int array indexed by format; valid format indices are 0..12, and tag_bytes[format] gives the per-component byte size (1,1,2,4,8,1,1,2,4,8,4,8 for formats 1..12).
number_bytes is computed as (size_t)components * tag_bytes[format]; the check number_bytes < components rejects overflow of that multiplication.
If number_bytes <= 4, p is set to q+8 (inline value within the 12-byte directory entry); otherwise p is set from an offset field.
For the offset case, dir_offset must be nonnegative and < length, (size_t)dir_offset+number_bytes must not wrap and must be <= length, and p is then exif+dir_offset.
Before formatting, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-tag_bytes[format].
values.evidence: L652: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-tag_bytes[format])))

values.claim: For the string/default format, p must satisfy p >= exif and p <= exif+length-number_bytes.
values.evidence: L733: if ((p < exif) || (p > (exif+length-number_bytes)))

values.claim: For BYTE/UNDEFINED and STRING formats, value is allocated with AcquireQuantumMemory((size_t)number_bytes+1UL, sizeof(*value)) when ~((size_t)number_bytes) >= 1, i.e. number_bytes+1 does not wrap.

values.claim: The BYTE/UNDEFINED and STRING loops write value[0..number_bytes-1] and then value[number_bytes]='\0', so the allocation of number_bytes+1 bytes is exactly sufficient.
In EXIFMultipleValues/EXIFMultipleFractions, p1 starts at p and is advanced by size bytes per component for components iterations, so the last read is at p+(components-1)*size.

values.claim: number_entries is read as an unsigned short from directory; before reading the next-IFD offset, directory+2+(12*number_entries)+4 must be <= exif+length.

values.claim: For '#'/'@' tag specifications, property is advanced by 6, n=strlen(property) must equal 4, and n is then divided by 4.
tag is initialized to ~0UL and must not remain ~0UL after parsing.
length is the string-info length of the exif profile and must be at least 6 before scanning, and at least 16 after locating the EXIF header.
id is read as a signed short from exif; id==0x4949 selects LSBEndian, id==0x4D4D selects MSBEndian, otherwise the function returns.
For all==2, key is formatted as '#%04lx' when tag_value < 0x10000, as '@%04lx' with tag_value & 0xffff when tag_value < 0x20000, otherwise as 'unknown'.
values.evidence:
L793: if (tag_value < 0x10000)
L794: (void) FormatLocaleString(key,MaxTextExtent,"#%04lx",
L797: if (tag_value < 0x20000)
L798: (void) FormatLocaleString(key,MaxTextExtent,"@%04lx",
L799: (unsigned long) (tag_value & 0xffff));
